name: NCAA Division III Cross Country Championships
where: Northfield, MN · Bill Huyck Championship Course · host Carleton
headline: NCAA Championships: Wartburg vs. North Central, NYU goes for two
summary: No. 1 Wartburg and No. 2 North Central (Ill.) split the first-place votes after North Central won the Midwest Regional, 59 to 82, with No. 3 Johns Hopkins close behind. In the women’s race, unanimous No. 1 NYU goes for back-to-back titles, with No. 2 Williams the top threat.
